Are you hot enough to be admitted?

Bakar / Ganz / Razman / Rajesh / News Anchor / Pirate #2 (voice)

He's boldly going where no house pet has ever gone before.
Owl / Frog / Wombat / Other Wallaby / Desert Mouse (voice)

If you love me, why are you making me choose?

Something Extraordinary Is About To Happen

10 years behind bars, the only chance to find the truth.

Docteur Emmanuel François Xavier Bernier dit / Manu

Filmed without the benefit of cages, mechanical sharks and other protective devices.
